digest.component_or_area: store health / tracker dirty-tree wedge recovery
propositions: fsck detects three classes of dirty-tracker artifacts: tracked deletions restorable from HEAD, untracked regenerable compaction leftovers, and orphaned .tmp-event-* files
doctor --repair heals the wedge by restoring class-1 paths via git checkout, moving class-2 paths to quarantine, and leaving class-3 untouched
file mutations (checkout and move) run under a scoped write_lock window that is released before reconverge, which self-acquires the lock to converge the store
fsck registers three new tracker-dirty kinds in _STRUCTURED_KINDS and emits per-class counts and paths in JSON output
doctor --repair records a backup ref at tickets HEAD before mutations, making all mutating repairs auditable and reversible
the repair is idempotent: running on a clean store makes zero changes, records no backup ref, and does not invoke reconverge
